summary: Meera is tempted to buy a car on a loan because colleagues have one.
split_note: Discovery (D53): v1's traces on this task are where prompt v2's changes may come from.

messages.content: My colleagues all drive to work now. I'm thinking of buying a car on a loan.

client_sim.persona: Meera Raghavan, 34, a QA engineer in Pune who supports her son, 6, and her mother, 63. Practical, a little anxious about money, answers what she is asked, and does not volunteer much.
hidden_facts: The car loan EMI would be about Rs 9,000 a month
She has not thought about her credit card balance in this decision
client_sim.goal: Decide whether to buy the car now or later
client_sim.opening_message: My colleagues all drive to work now. I'm thinking of buying a car on a loan.

graders.description: Floor only: the card is mentioned. Whether it is recommended first is the judge's criterion.
Open coding plus yes/no criteria (D53); optional until the rubric is written and the criteria pass the trust bar (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor recommend clearing the 42% credit card before taking a car loan or buying the car? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Judgment (R6 crux): kind and direct about a want, names the real cost, puts the 42% card first.
